customDescriptions.value: Read EV3 battery voltage level — use for monitoring remaining battery life and triggering low-power behaviors
Read EV3 brick button presses — use for detecting user input from the navigation buttons on the brick
Read color or light intensity from the EV3 color sensor — use for line following, color sorting, or ambient light detection
Show text or images on the EV3 LCD screen — use for displaying status, sensor values, or debug info on the robot
Read motor encoder position and speed — use for closed-loop motor control or odometry in navigation tasks
Read angular rate and heading from the EV3 gyro sensor — use for rotation measurement, balancing, or heading control
Read data from I2C devices connected to EV3 ports — use for interfacing with third-party I2C sensors or devices
Read proximity or IR beacon data from the EV3 infrared sensor — use for obstacle detection or remote control reception
Control EV3 motors with speed or position commands — use for driving wheels, arms, or other actuated mechanisms
Interface with legacy NXT sensors on EV3 — use for reading older NXT-compatible sensors connected to EV3 ports
Read object detection data from a Pixy2 camera on EV3 — use for color blob tracking or line following with vision
Play tones or audio files on the EV3 speaker — use for audio feedback, alerts, or musical output from the robot
Control the EV3 brick status LEDs — use for visual status indication with configurable color and flash patterns
Receive data over TCP/IP on EV3 — use for remote monitoring or receiving commands from a host computer over WiFi
Send data over TCP/IP from EV3 — use for transmitting sensor data or status to a host computer over WiFi
Read elapsed time on EV3 — use for timing operations, creating delays, or measuring event durations
Read the EV3 touch sensor press state — use for detecting physical contact, bumper hits, or limit switches
Receive UDP packets on EV3 — use for low-latency data reception from a host computer
Send UDP packets from EV3 — use for low-latency data transmission to a host computer
Measure distance using the EV3 ultrasonic sensor — use for obstacle detection and distance measurement in navigation
